name: Whiteboard
description: A whiteboard for sketches and diagrams: Excalidraw in a tab of its own, kept in this app. Your apps' agents read the board, draw shapes, labels and arrows on it, and look at it with you.

tools.name: contents
tools.title: Read the whiteboard
tools.description: Read what the whiteboard holds: each shape with its id, kind, words, position and size, each arrow with the shapes it joins, and each free text. Positions are in the board's own units, x to the right and y down.

tools.name: draw
tools.title: Draw on the whiteboard
tools.description: Draw shapes on the whiteboard, to the right of what it holds, and show them to the person. A rectangle, an ellipse or a diamond holds its label inside; a text is free words; an arrow joins two shapes of the same call, named by their key, and may carry a label. Give x and y to lay shapes out yourself, in board units relative to each other; shapes without them go in a row from left to right. The person can move, change or undo everything you draw.

shapes.description: The shapes to draw, arrows after the shapes they join

key.description: A name of your own for the shape, which an arrow's from and to name

label.description: The words inside the shape or on the arrow, or the text itself

from.description: For an arrow: the key of its first shape

to.description: For an arrow: the key of its second shape

color.description: The line and text colour, as #rrggbb

fill.description: The fill colour of a shape, as #rrggbb

tools.name: look
tools.title: Look at the whiteboard
tools.description: See the whiteboard as the person sees it, as a picture.
